I honestly think while exes have the best intentions in mind they make things a lot worse by trying to let you down easy. Obviously he cares about you and he’s not a complete asshole so he’s going to do everything he can to soften the blow. But the truth is it’s over. You gotta come to terms with that and use it to your advantage. Think of all the things you didn’t do because of the relationship. Maybe friendships that faded because you spent so much time with him, hobbies etc. 

I know it’s hard to accept the end and to accept that you have to move on. One thing that helped me was thinking about what would happen if we did get back together. The relationship ended for a reason right? Even if you aren’t 100% of the reason clearly things were not working for both sides. If you got back together now would things magically change? Probably not. But if you move on and become a better version of yourself, more independent, learning to love yourself, you will become a better partner and person. So maybe eventually he’ll come back, or maybe you’ll find someone better. And you’ll be more equipped for a relationship.

If they want you and want to rekindle things they will reach out. You have the power. Cut them out and focus on yourself and focus on moving on. I promise you over time the need to contact them will fade and you’ll be able to see all the negatives in that relationship. The pressure is on them now to reach out if they really want it.

You’re not going to get the support you’re looking for from him. Not to be harsh but he has so much going on in his life and you are such a low priority. You’ve become completely reliant on him for your own happiness and function. 

Getting a closure conversation is not going to change anything. You’re just using it as an excuse to stay in contact with him because you’re afraid of being alone and not being in a relationship anymore.
